s1.title: Knowledge has always passed from person to person
s1.text: That is how it was on the steppe, by the elder's yurt. It still is: Abadan & Co. carries that line on — from leadership to drilling.

s2.title: 1864. Turgai
s2.text: Ybyrai Altynsarin opened the first school for Kazakh children in Turgai. His name lives on in our platform, ibirAi.

s3.title: From 1920 — learning at the lathe
s3.text: Factory apprenticeship schools taught workers at the plants. We also train engineers and workers using their own equipment and real work tasks.

s4.title: Today — in person, on site and online
s4.text: More than 200 experts, six subject areas, and programmes built around your company’s real business cases.

s5.title: Tomorrow — a mentor in everyone's phone
s5.text: ibirAi reaches workers on their phones: 10 minutes per shift and a comprehension check for everyone.

after.contactSubtitle: Tell us about your team's task — we prepare a commercial proposal the same day.
